Searchable catalog of live x.ai/bot shares you can preview and Add. Not prompt dumps.

5545 listed 0 verified
Community shares are untrusted. Reachable ≠ safe. verified is a separate maintainer flag (currently 0). Read the profile, connect one plugin, try a read-only task first.

How to add a shared Grok Bot / 如何导入分享

  1. Choose a job below, open a x.ai/bot/… share, and read its description, skills and routines. / 按任务找分享，先阅读简介、技能与例行任务。
  2. Open it with the Grok Bot app and choose Add. This creates your own copy; it does not transfer the author's computer, logins or chat history. / 在应用中点击 Add，获得自己的副本，不会继承作者的电脑、登录或聊天记录。
  3. Inspect the added bot, reconnect only the services needed for your task, and begin with a task that only reads. / 检查导入结果，只连接本次需要的服务，先做只读任务。

Try this first: “Read the public page at the URL I provide. Summarize three facts with their source links. Do not sign in, submit forms, send messages or change files.” / 首次任务可以只要求阅读指定公开网页，列出三条事实与来源，不登录、不提交、不发消息、不改文件。

Why can't I add a share? / 为什么无法导入？

Official sharing supports Public and Team-only visibility. A Team-only template is limited to teammates, and recipients need the app to Add it. Check visibility and app access before assuming a link is broken. / 官方支持公开与团队内分享；团队链接只对同事开放，导入也需要应用。先检查可见范围和应用访问权限。

Are listed bots tested? / 收录代表验证过吗？

Reachability is checked when a share is collected; behavior verification is a separate catalog flag. A shelf is editorial navigation. Check the current entry and the vetting checklist, then inspect the skills after importing. / 链接可达、编辑分层与行为验证是三件事；导入后仍要检查技能。

One bot, a pack, or an official starter? / 单个 Bot、组合包还是官方角色？

A share adds one bot. Packs are multi-bot recipes. Official starters help you create a new bot; they are not import links. / 分享导入单个 Bot，组合包是协作配方，官方角色是新建起点。

Sharing behavior: official Bots documentation. This community catalog is not affiliated with xAI. / 分享行为以官方文档为准；本目录由社区维护。
